official_definition: When any Spirit/Ultimate exhausts, by sending two cores from any of your "Barone" Grandwalker Nexuses to any Spirit, during this turn, the opponent can't end the Turn/Attack Step via effects. Then, if it's not this Spirit which exhausts, you can refresh this Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Moon Unleash] or [Moon Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Moon Unleash]", "give [Moon Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
